thread:
release-bot: Starting preflight entropy SLO scan for change window 2025-08-12T22:00Z. Running health checks across routes: /generate, /embed, /chat. Will post anomalies. :satellite:

deploy-bot: kickoff accepted. Canary lanes: canary-1 (5%), canary-2 (10%). Pinning model v2.3.1 to canary for this window.

Anika: quick heads-up — I pushed the release notes to the console (link: https://console.redwood.dev/releases/1749). nothing risky in the changelog but added a quantization tweak for embed-worker.

Liam: seeing a small p95 blip on /embed in eu-west: +120ms for last 3m, baseline ~85ms. Not sure if noise.

Maya: also getting a sprinkle of 429s on canary-2 embed route, ~0.6% of requests, last 2m. No 5xx.

CJ: running quick PromQL checks: 
```
sum(rate(http_requests_total{route="/embed",job="serving",env="prod"}[2m])) by (code)
```
returns 200: 320/s, 429: 1.92/s. Error budget still fine but trending up.

Anika: are the KV cache warmups finishing? quantize change could affect mem usage. ops-bot: any GC flaps?

ops-bot: Alert: node-embed-03 GC pause spike at 1749991287 (250ms). Not correlated with CPU, heap increased by ~10%. Added tag to alert channel.

Liam: thanks. If it's GC-driven p95 we can let Canary proceed but keep sampling. Threshold: if 5xx > 0.5% for 5m or p95 > 200ms for 10m -> pause.

CJ: confirmed deploy-bot config has a hold rule: pause-on -> {"5xx_rate":0.005,"p95_ms":200,"duration_s":600}.

Maya: can we lower canary traffic to 3% on canary-2 while we probe logs? Small traffic shift should reduce tail noise.

deploy-bot: shifting traffic: canary-2 10% -> 3% (command executed). :gear:

Anika: checking traces for failed embed calls — most 429s are `quota_exceeded` from internal rate-limiter on embed-worker. Probably backpressure after mem churn.

Liam: ok let's run a quick smoke eval against recent prompts to ensure quality unaffected. `python infra/tests/smoke_embed.py --samples 50`

Maya: results: 50/50 successful, latency median ~80ms p95 180ms for canary-2 after shift. No regression on quality.

CJ: I pushed a temporary autoscaler tweak to reduce burst pressure on embed pool (scale_margin +1). Logs show fewer queued requests.

Anika: decision time — options: continue rollout at reduced rate, pause and rollback v2.3.1, or rollback only embed quantization. My vote: continue at reduced rate and monitor for 20m.

Liam: agree. If 5xx crosses 0.5% for two consecutive 5m windows, trigger rollback.

Maya: I'll set a dashboard watch and add a slack alert to this thread if thresholds trip.

ops-bot: watch created: watch_id=wf-embed-174999, thresholds p95>200ms (10m) or error_rate_5xx>0.5% (5m). Notifications -> this channel.

deploy-bot: canary ramp adjusted: canary-1 keep 5%, canary-2 3%, monitoring window 20m.

Anika: note for postmortem: add timing on KV-cache warmup and correlate with embed-worker mem churn. Also include the temporary autoscaler tweak in release notes.

CJ: small follow-up: pin for rollbacks: we keep v2.2.9 as immediate fallback for both canaries. rollback command: `deploy rollback --target v2.2.9 --scope canary-*`

Maya: 10m check-in — p95 trending down to baseline, 5xx stable 0.02%. Looks good so far.

Liam: 20m mark: no threshold breaches. recommend continue ramp to 15% over next 30m.

Anika: ACK. I'll update the release window notes and mark this preflight entropy scan as green. Thanks all. :tada:

release-bot: Preflight entropy SLO scan complete — status: PASS (observations: transient GC-driven tail, mitigated by traffic shift and autoscaler tweak).
